description: This PHP source file provides a web interface for editing port forwarding rules, including form handling, validation, and dynamic UI updates. It integrates with backend configuration via AJAX and includes client-side validation for IPv4 and IPv6 addresses, ports, and service names.

methods.name: populateIPv6Addr
methods.description: Parses an IPv6 address string into an array of its segments, handling compressed notation (::).

methods.name: IsBlank
methods.description: Checks if input fields with a given prefix are blank, excluding specific IPv6 address segments.

methods.name: GetAddress
methods.description: Concatenates values of input fields with a given prefix into a single address string separated by a specified separator.

methods.name: isIp6AddrRequired
methods.description: Determines if IPv6 address input is required based on current form inputs.

methods.name: ipv6_in_int
methods.description: Converts an IPv6 address segment array into an integer array for comparison.

methods.name: isHex
methods.description: Checks if a string is a valid hexadecimal number.

methods.name: validate_v6addr_pool
methods.description: Validates that the IPv6 address range is correctly ordered (start < end).

methods.name: isIp4AddrRequired
methods.description: Checks if IPv4 address input is required based on current form inputs.
